units.source_text: 这话出自普通人的口并不稀奇，现在从祖父嘴里说出来，良心不允许我等闲视之。

en.t: If these words had come from an ordinary person, they would not have been surprising, but now that they had come from my grandfather, my conscience would not allow me to take them lightly.

units.source_text: 我浮想联翩，涌起了某种不安的思绪（这里有五个字不清楚）。

en.t: My thoughts wandered one after another, and a certain uneasy feeling welled up in me (five characters here are unclear).
